paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: : MMLU Pro confidence vs. accuracy
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy values as a function of initial confidence. The x-axis is labeled "Initial Confidence" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.81 to 0.99, with tick labels displayed at intervals of 0.01. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and has a linear scale ranging from -0.01 to 1.00. A blue line with solid style and circle markers represents "Final Accuracy," starting at 0.84 and ending at 0.98. A dashed orange line with diamond markers represents "Δ Accuracy," beginning at 0.84 and decreasing to 0.14. A green line with a triangular marker represents "Initial Accuracy," starting at 0.51 and ending at 0.87. Error bars are shown for each data point on all lines.
